title: Endorser's Obligation to Exercise Due Diligence

content.scenario: A celebrity endorses a product and makes claims about its benefits. To avoid liability, the celebrity must exercise due diligence to verify the veracity of the claims made in the advertisement.
content.outcome: The endorser must exercise due diligence to verify the veracity of the claims made in the advertisement regarding the product or service being endorsed, to avoid liability to a penalty under sub-sections (2) and (3) of Section 21 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What is the responsibility of an endorser in India?
How can an endorser avoid liability for a false advertisement?
